thread:
priya_acme: Hey team — since ~2024-12-01 10:15 UTC our streaming /v1/generate calls sometimes truncate mid-stream. Client SDK then retries and we’re seeing what looks like double billing (same prompt counted twice) + intermittent 5xx spikes. Sample request_id: r-3f8a2. Can you advise?

alex_support: Sorry about that — we’re looking. Can you paste the full request_id(s) + a minimal curl or sdk payload and the last byte you received?

priya_acme: Two ids we saw: r-3f8a2 and r-3f8a2-retry. Last client output ended at: "Assistant: Here’s the first part of the answer..." then socket closed. Minimal curl: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"rwd-1","stream":true,"input":"..."}'```

alex_support: Thanks — escalating to eng-sre and SDK. /cc @devon_sre @maria_sdk

devon_sre: I’m seeing upstream resets for r-3f8a2 around 2024-12-01T10:15:12Z: `HTTP/2 RST_STREAM (0x8) from upstream` and a 503 returned mid-stream. Edge kept a partial set of DATA frames and we propagated them. Snippet from edge log: ```[10:15:12Z] req=r-3f8a2 upstream_status=503 rst=REFUSED_STREAM bytes_sent=237 last_frame=DATA```

maria_sdk: FYI the SDK default behavior is to retry on connection resets for streaming. It restarts the request and appends new chunks — but billing on our side is per-request token emission, so that retry can produce duplicate billed tokens. Workaround: set `max_stream_retries=0` or supply an idempotency key header `x-idempotency-key`. We'll patch SDK soon.

sam_oncall: Temporary mitigation applied for tenant `acme-corp` at 2024-12-01T10:45Z: forced fallback to non-streaming generate for their routed region and increased ingress keepalive to 90s. Should stop the resets while we investigate. Roll id p-2024-12-01-10:45.

nora_support_mgr: We're sending a customer note: "Sorry for the disruption — we've applied a temporary fix to stop duplicate charges and are investigating root cause. We'll follow up with credits and next steps." Priya — is that OK to send?

priya_acme: Yes please send. Also we estimate ~1.9M tokens that look duplicated — can you confirm count and credits?

alex_support: Acknowledged. Eng will run a token dedupe audit and we’ll follow up with exact token count and credit amount.

devon_sre: Root-cause hypothesis: edge proxy intermittently RSTs streaming connections under certain window exhaustion bursts, and the SDK aggressive retry merges cause duplicated consumption. Action items: 1) edge proxy patch to better handle half-closed H2 streams (rollout ~24h), 2) SDK hotfix to avoid auto-retries for streaming (0–48h), 3) audit job to compute duplicated tokens per request id.

maria_sdk: Hotfix PR opened: https://git.internal/pr/1234 — targets SDK release 0.12.3 with `stream.retry_on_reset = false` by default. Short-term: clients can set `max_stream_retries=0` or pass `x-idempotency-key`.

alex_support: Update sent to customer at 2024-12-01T10:52Z. Mitigation in place. We’ll coordinate credits once audit completes.

ci_deploy_bot: [deploy] p-2024-12-01-10:45 -> edge-config scaled +10, keepalive 90s.

priya_acme: Thanks — please cc billing on credits and confirm when SDK hotfix is published.

alex_support: Will do. Marking as monitoring — temporary fix active, eng working on permanent patch. Will update in this thread when audit + patches are complete. :thumbsup:

(devon_sre later): Edge fix merged to canary at 2024-12-02T08:10Z; rolling to prod 24h. SDK hotfix merged, release scheduled in 48h. Audit in progress — ETA token count 6–12h.

alex_support: Final note: customer notified, temporary fallback removed once we confirmed no further resets at 2024-12-02T11:30Z. Action items tracked in internal ticket INF-4821.

priya_acme: Appreciate the quick turnaround — will wait on credit confirmation.

alex_support: Thanks — closing support escalation once billing confirms credit applied.
